errors.text_span: Графиката се състои от две подграфики, съответно за търговия с ЕС и с държави извън ЕС.
errors.evidence: The figure consists of two subplots, but they represent 'Внос' (Imports) and 'Износ' (Exports), not trade with EU and non-EU countries. The EU/non-EU distinction is for the data series within each plot.

errors.text_span: показана с линия от малки кръстчета
errors.evidence: The line for 'Извън ЕС' (Outside EU) is a dashed line, not a line of small crosses.

errors.text_span: През 2004 г. стойността на линията "Общо" е приблизително 10%
errors.evidence: The description provides a single set of values for each line, failing to distinguish between the 'Imports' and 'Exports' plots. The starting value for 'Общо' (Total) is approximately 15% for Imports and 23% for Exports, neither of which is 10%.

errors.text_span: Линията "ЕС" започва от около 20% през 2004 г. и достига приблизително 40% през 2010 г., след което намалява до около 25% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly merges data from two plots. For 'ЕС' (EU), the starting value in 2004 is ~10% (Imports) or ~15% (Exports), not 20%. The peak value is ~30% in both plots, not 40%.

errors.text_span: Линията "Извън ЕС" започва от около 5% през 2004 г., достига връх от приблизително 60% през 2008 г., след което намалява до около 35% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly merges data from two plots and reports inaccurate values. For 'Извън ЕС' (Outside EU), the starting value in 2004 is ~22% (Imports) or ~37% (Exports), not 5%. The peak for Imports is ~64% in 2011, not 2008. The ending value in 2019 is ~46% (Imports) or ~40% (Exports), not 35%.

The description fails to describe the data trends for the 'Внос' (Imports) and 'Износ' (Exports) plots separately. This is a fundamental structural feature of the figure, and its omission makes the entire data description misleading and inaccurate.
